title: Add light on off orbit render script
objective: Add a checked-in shell helper script for rendering the flashlight orbit collection with two light settings: light_on and light_off. The script should be runnable as a single command from the repo and should not rely on the user pasting heredoc syntax.
instructions: Create a small shell script under examples/flashlight, likely examples/flashlight/render_orbit_light_on_off.sh.

The script should cd to the repo root or otherwise be robust when run from the repo, write a temporary light settings JSON file, and run examples/flashlight/run_orbit_collection.py in render mode using examples/flashlight/orbit_spec.json and examples/flashlight/orbit_collection_output.
Use light_on enabled true intensity 30000.0 and light_off enabled false intensity 0.0; yaw/pitch offsets 0.0.
Avoid heredoc syntax in the user-facing command. The script itself can use simple printf or another robust shell-native way to write JSON.
Add a concise README mention if appropriate so users can find the helper.
Run shell syntax validation and any focused non-sim checks that do not require the simulator.
expected_outputs: Script path and exact command to run it.
definition_of_done: A repo-local single-command script exists for light on/off render.
Focused validation passes without running the simulator.
